name: phase29a_first_campaign
objective: Improve the cost-adjusted robustness of the current fundamental_momentum_50_50_v1 family without modifying the frozen operational model. Vary only the approved bounded dimensions (blend weights, Top-25 vs Top-50, supported sector treatment, supported member/exit buffer, supported rebalance treatment, cost sensitivity, defensive overlay off vs current) against the reproduced baseline.

baseline.notes: Scientific baseline = the RAW monthly target reconstruction (exit_buffer_fraction 0.0): the exact configuration that reproduces the owned evidence file historical_book_returns.csv 120/120 months at that file's 12.5 bps-per-side convention (net = gross - 0.0025 * one-way turnover, the same rate as the paper desk's COST_BPS_PER_SIDE). The live engine's EXIT_BUFFER_FRACTION 0.20 is an OPERATIONAL holdings/action-layer hysteresis, not part of the evidence construction (it mismatches the reference in 111/120 months); it is studied separately via the labeled sensitivity dimension exit_buffer_fractions [0.0, 0.2] (hyp_exit_buffer). baseline.cost_bps_per_side 25.0 is the deliberately conservative Phase 10-C evaluation standard (2x the desk execution rate); every cost level is applied once, from gross, never stacked.
